summary_1line: King Dasharatha recounts accidentally killing a hermit’s son, recalls the curse of dying from grief for his own son, and finally dies mourning Rama’s exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: The blind hermit parents kneel in the forest, embracing the blood-stained body of their dead son while King Dasharatha stands nearby in grief.
The young ascetic’s spirit rises in a celestial form beside Indra’s chariot, speaking to his mourning parents on the forest floor.
King Dasharatha lies on his bed in the palace at midnight, reaching out blindly while crying for Rama as the queens Kaushalya and Sumitra mourn beside him.
